facts.sub: Diga I’d like to exchange this sweater. Peça Do you have a large? Pergunte Is there a different color? Decida com I’m going to take the green one.

facts.label: Recibo de presente
facts.sub: Muitas lojas dão um recibo de presente, que não mostra o preço. Assim a pessoa que ganhou pode trocar o item por outro tamanho, outra cor ou crédito na loja.

facts.label: Tamanhos americanos
facts.sub: Roupas americanas usam S, M, L e XL, e calças usam números de cintura. Um M daqui pode ser diferente do M de outro país, então é bom provar antes.

pages.title: A different color · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday afternoon in Portland. Nina has a new wool sweater with a round collar. It has a red ribbon, but it is too small. She walks into a clothing store with the bag. A clerk named Dan stands near a rack of hangers. He smiles and asks if she needs help.
“Hello! How can I help you?” says Dan. “I’d like to exchange this sweater.” says Nina. “Sure. What is the problem?” says Dan.
